program.section_heading: Business Information Worker — Associate of Arts (AA) Degree
outcomes: Develop a solution to a business problem using the most appropriate business application software.
Apply software tools to function effectively as a team member using collaborative web-based workspaces.
Construct business presentations that are accurate, well-organized, and are appropriate to the audience and purpose.
Develop accurate accounting reports using appropriate spreadsheet and accounting software.
Organize customer service tasks using customer relationship management software.

notes: Section header prints 'Major Units: 39  Total Units: Minimum of 60'; 39 recorded as total_units and the printed 'Minimum of 60' as degree_total (60-60). Reviewer may confirm whether 'Minimum of 60' should count as this award's degree total.
No general education pattern or GE units are named in this section.
The PSLO list for the A.A. begins at the top of page 83 after a page break; the stray line 'Computer Science (CSISA)' at the bottom of page 82 appears to be a running header and was ignored.
Catalog prints codes with leading zeros (CAOT 001 etc.); these match closed-list codes (CAOT 1 etc.).
The Certificate of Achievement of the same name prints an identical course list and outcomes; only the A.A. section was read.
